# Arenova Frontdesk — Complete Technical & Product Specification

## 1. Overview
- **Product Name**: Arenova Frontdesk
- **Website**: https://frontdesk.arenova.in
- **Parent Organization**: Arenova (https://arenova.in)
- **Primary Category**: Healthcare Practice Management & Patient Communication Software
- **Software Type**: Cloud-hosted Software-as-a-Service (SaaS)

## 2. Product Description
Arenova Frontdesk provides dental clinics, doctors, and healthcare practices with an AI-driven WhatsApp receptionist that works 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Instead of clinic staff spending hours answering repetitive WhatsApp messages about clinic hours, consultation fees, root canal costs, or doctor availability, Arenova Frontdesk handles routine patient interactions automatically.

## 3. Key Features & Workflows
1. **WhatsApp Patient Engagement**: Connects directly via WhatsApp Cloud API or Baileys multi-device protocol, receiving incoming messages and answering in under 2 seconds.
2. **Calendar Coordination**: Queries Google Calendar in real-time, finds open working hours, respects doctor lunch and tea breaks, and reserves pending appointment requests.
3. **Emergency Red-Flag Detection**: Scans patient queries for symptoms of cardiac arrest, severe bleeding, breathing difficulty, or anaphylaxis, advising immediate contact with emergency medical services.
4. **Clinic Knowledge Base**: Stores clinic-specific consultation fees, doctor OPD hours, parking information, and pre-procedure fasting rules.
5. **Staff Handover**: At any time, human receptionists can click "Take Over" in the web dashboard to pause the AI and chat directly with the patient.
6. **Automated Review Collection**: Configurable post-appointment delay (e.g. 60 minutes) to send a polite thank-you message with a direct link to review the clinic on Google Maps.

## 4. Supported Healthcare Specialties
- Dental & Orthodontic Practices
- Dermatology & Aesthetic Clinics
- General Medicine & Paediatrics
- Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation Centers
- Ophthalmology & Optical Centers

## 5. Pricing Structure
- **Starter Plan**: ₹999/month (or ₹9,590/year)
  - 500 patient conversations per month
  - 1 WhatsApp clinic number
  - 1 Google Calendar sync
- **Pro Plan**: ₹1,499/month (or ₹14,390/year)
  - 1,500 patient conversations per month
  - Multi-staff dashboard access
  - Automated Google Review requests
- **Growth Plan**: ₹2,999/month (or ₹28,790/year)
  - 4,000 patient conversations per month
  - Multiple doctor calendar schedules
  - Priority SLA support
